tests.name: Trash2 excluded from keyboard tab order when input empty
tests.expected: When composer input is empty, pressing Tab should skip the clear-draft button. When input has text, Tab should land on it and show a focus ring

tests.name: Send button responds to mouse click
tests.expected: Clicking the send button with the mouse should send the message. The button should visually respond to hover and click

tests.name: Sent message does not reappear as draft
tests.expected: Type a message and send it immediately (within 1 second). Switch conversations and come back. The sent message should NOT appear as a draft in the composer

tests.name: Copy feedback still works (regression check)
tests.expected: Copy button shows checkmark after click, reverts after ~1.5s (same as before — regression check)

tests.name: Draft restore still works (regression check)
tests.expected: Type text, switch conversation, switch back — draft restored (same as before — regression check)
